name: backend_partition_degradation
description: Pins FSM.md §8 degraded operation: on partition_start the plane disconnects but the episode keeps RUNNING; sustained heartbeat loss fires the staleness tripwire (TripwireEvent with requested_verb VERB_HOLD, plus the request_verb{VERB_HOLD} effect), cloud-dependent grants demote with reason 'partition', events emitted while partitioned (here the tripwire, the demotion, and a MARK_KIND_START mark) buffer locally — asserted via the snapshot's exact plane.buffered_events count — and partition_end restores the plane (connected, empty buffer) and re-promotes the partition-demoted grants with reason 'control plane reconnected'. Judgment calls: heartbeat staleness threshold is assumed to be at most 2 s of silence (the scenario advances 2 s); emission order within the staleness batch is pinned tripwire-then-grant per §8 bullet order; the demotion asserts only {to: DEMOTED, reason: 'partition'} without pinning which verb degrades; the mark uses MARK_KIND_START because END_* marks would terminate the episode (E10); in-order transport replay of the buffered events on reconnect is the control-plane client's contract, pinned by waddle-controlplane's own tests rather than an FSM emission here (the FSM does not re-emit buffered events).
